items.title: Register for the Broome County occupancy tax
items.authority: Broome County Office of Management and Budget
items.description: Hotels, motels, bed and breakfasts and online remarketers apply for a Certificate of Registration (Certificate of Authority) with the Office of Management and Budget, giving facility details such as address, type and number of rooms.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Broome County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Broome County Office of Management and Budget
items.description: Operators file a quarterly return with payment to the Office of Management and Budget and remit the 5% occupancy tax. A late return adds a 5% penalty plus 1% of the tax per month in interest.
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of 30 or more consecutive days)

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Cattaraugus County occupancy tax
items.description: Every operator who must collect the occupancy tax completes a Certification of Registration and returns it to the County Treasurer. The tax covers hotels, motels, bed and breakfasts, inns, cabins, condominiums, cottages, campgrounds and tourist homes.
items.deadline: At least twenty days before opening, buying or starting a facility

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Cattaraugus County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file quarterly for periods ending in February, May, August and November, with the return and payment due within 20 days (the 20th of March, June, September and December), and remit the 5% tax. A late payment adds a 5% penalty, and interest of 1% a month starts after 30 days.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Chautauqua County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file the county occupancy tax return with payment to the Director of Finance within 20 days after each quarter and remit the 5% tax (the county's finance page lists 5%; a 2023 proposal to raise it was not confirmed as adopted). Operators who collect under $1,500 a year may file once a year, by January 20. The registration steps were not found on the pages read.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: New York Tax Law section 1202-h lets Chemung County tax hotel and motel rooms at up to 4%, but the county's own registration and return pages were not found. Other county-level business duties were not checked.

items.title: Register for the Jefferson County occupancy tax
items.description: Registered hotels, motels and short-term rentals register through the Treasurer's online portal (the office gives the link by phone). The county notes that Airbnb, VRBO and similar platforms have no collection agreement with it, so hosts must make sure the 3% tax is collected and then report it through the portal.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Jefferson County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file quarterly through the Treasurer's portal and remit the 3% tax on the per diem room rate, even when gross sales are zero.
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of 30 or more consecutive days)

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Nassau County occupancy tax
items.description: All owners of hotels and motels register with the County Treasurer and obtain a Certificate of Authority, which must be displayed where guests can see it. The operator collects a tax of 3% of the per diem room rate with the rent and remits it to the Treasurer (rate per the county page, which lists Local Law 5 of 2025 among its amendments). The page read does not give return due dates; filing is electronic.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Oneida County occupancy tax
items.description: Any new business renting one room or more completes a certification form for the Finance Department, which sends a permit that must be displayed. Hosts of short-term rentals (stays under 30 consecutive nights) have also had to register their unit with the Commissioner of Finance since January 1, 2026; the county was not charging for it.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Oneida County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file quarterly returns with the Commissioner of Finance within 20 days after each quarter ends and remit the 5% tax on the per diem room rate. A late return carries a 5% penalty plus interest, and records must be kept for three years.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Onondaga County occupancy tax
items.description: Hotel and motel operators register with the county Commissioner of Finance, who issues a Certificate of Authority (within five days) that lets the operator collect the 7% room occupancy tax. Short-term rental hosts register their property with the county as well; that registration is valid for two years.
items.deadline: Within three days of filing a certificate of registration

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Onondaga County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file a quarterly room occupancy tax return and remit the 7% tax; the return must be postmarked by the due date (metered mail is not accepted). A late return or payment adds 5% a month plus 1% monthly interest.
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of 30 or more consecutive days)

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Orange County occupancy tax
items.description: Every lodging facility in the county registers with the Commissioner of Finance, who assigns an identification number and supplies a Certificate of Authority, forms and instructions. The certificate must be displayed prominently. The operator collects the 5% tax from guests and holds it in trust for the county.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Orange County occupancy tax return
items.description: Operators file a Return of Tax on Occupancy of Hotel and Motel Rooms for each period ending the last day of February, May, August and November, within 20 days after the period closes. Late returns bring penalties and interest.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: New York Tax Law section 1202-k authorizes a Rockland County hotel and motel room tax of up to 3% administered by the Commissioner of Finance, but the county's current rate, registration and return dates were not found on its website. Other county-level business duties were not checked.

items.title: Register for and pay the Saratoga County occupancy tax
items.description: The County Treasurer collects and regulates the county occupancy tax and runs a registration and tax portal for short-term rental owners and operators. The rate was 1% under state law as of early 2025, and a county resolution of January 2026 refers to a local law setting up a short-term rental registry and applying the tax to short-term rental units; the current rate and the return dates were not confirmed.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Steuben County occupancy tax
items.description: Hotels, motels, inns and bed and breakfasts register with the Finance Office on a paper application for a Certificate of Authority; short-term rentals booked through platforms such as Airbnb or Vrbo can apply on paper or through the county's online system.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Steuben County occupancy tax return
items.description: A return is required every quarter, even when no tax is owed, and the county tax is 4% of room income. The hotel and motel return lists due dates of March 20, June 20, September 20 and December 20; the platform short-term rental form uses calendar quarters due April 20, July 20, October 20 and January 20, so confirm which form applies. A late return adds a 5% penalty plus 1% a month in interest.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Suffolk County occupancy tax
items.authority: Suffolk County Comptroller, Hotel and Motel Tax
items.description: Every facility that rents lodging for under 30 days in Suffolk County must register with the county, including residences and tourist homes, not only hotels and motels. Operating unregistered carries a fine of $50 a day per facility.
items.deadline: Within ten days of the first rental

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Suffolk County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Suffolk County Comptroller, Hotel and Motel Tax
items.description: Registered facilities file through the county's portal and remit the 5.5% occupancy tax (rate effective June 1, 2023) on the per diem room rate every quarter. A late filing adds a 10% penalty plus 1% monthly interest starting 30 days after the deadline.
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of 30 or more consecutive days)

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Sullivan County occupancy tax
items.authority: Sullivan County Treasurer, Room Tax Division
items.description: Any facility rented for 90 consecutive days or less to an occupant who does not own it applies to the County Treasurer for a Certificate of Authority. Registration is renewed every two years (the current period runs to December 31, 2026).

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Sullivan County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Sullivan County Treasurer, Room Tax Division
items.description: Operators file a room tax return every quarter, whether or not tax is owed, and remit the 5% tax; returns for periods ending in February, May, August and November are due within 20 days (the 20th of March, June, September and December). Annual filers file within 20 days after August 31.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Tompkins County occupancy tax
items.description: Lodging properties register with the Finance Department using the county's online form (or a paper copy by request) to obtain a Certificate of Authority. Short-term rental units pay a $125 registration fee per unit; hotels and motels pay none. Establishments with an existing certificate were asked to re-register.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Tompkins County occupancy tax return
items.description: Returns and payments are quarterly for periods ending in February, May, August and November, due on the 20th of March, June, September and December. The county's room occupancy tax law sets the rate at 4% of the rent (rate taken from a 2019 copy of the law).
exemptions: Permanent residents (stays of more than 30 days)
Certain religious, charitable or educational stays and New York or United States government stays

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: No county general business license or business personal property return was found; the county's business filing is the occupancy tax for lodging operators.

items.title: Register for the Ulster County occupancy tax
items.description: Hotel, motel and short-term rental operators must obtain a Certificate of Authority from the county at no cost and display it at the property. It applies to operators of lodging only.
items.deadline: No later than three days after commencing business

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Ulster County occupancy tax return
items.description: Lodging operators file a quarterly occupancy tax return and remit the 4% tax collected from occupants, even when nothing is owed. Booking services such as Airbnb and VRBO remit for the bookings they facilitate.
exemptions: Permanent residents occupying a room for at least 90 consecutive days

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Register for the Westchester County occupancy tax
items.authority: Westchester County Department of Finance, Room Occupancy Tax division
items.description: Hotel and room operators register under Chapter 285 of the county code, submitting an Application for Certificate of Authority and an online-filing verification form to the Department of Finance. The county then issues the Certificate of Authority that allows the operator to collect the 3% room occupancy tax from guests.
items.deadline: Within three days of opening or starting a hotel or room occupancy business

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Westchester County occupancy tax return
items.authority: Westchester County Department of Finance, Room Occupancy Tax division
items.description: Every registered operator files a return each quarter through the county's online system and remits the 3% tax collected, even when there were no room rentals. A return falling due on a weekend or bank holiday is due the next business day.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental
